hero.intro: Our Proven Influencer Strategies and how they can help your brand activations and marketing

image.alt: Three smartphone screens displaying promotional content—cosmetics sale, donut ideas, and new sound experience—with three badges below for top influencer marketing and TikTok talent management agencies in 2024 and 2025.

tabs.title: Influencer Activations
tabs.html:
Get consumers talking about your brand in an authentic and impactful way. Our creative team builds influencer activations that connect your brand directly with the audiences you want to reach. From short form platforms like TikTok and Instagram to long form storytelling on YouTube or livestreams on Twitch and Kick, we design campaigns that spark conversations and capture attention where it matters most.

We manage every detail of your campaign, from influencer selection and creative strategy to content production and reporting, ensuring your brand is represented through voices that audiences already trust.
‍

image.alt: Woman crouching indoors pointing at a floor sign that reads 'Ready to succeed with Influencers overseas?' with Stride Social logo and website www.stride-social.com.

tabs.title: Influencer SEEDING
tabs.html:
If you are looking for performance-based and cost effective influencer marketing, influencer seeding is one of the most powerful strategies available. This approach allows your brand to send products directly to carefully selected influencers who genuinely connect with your target audience. By gifting products instead of paying large upfront fees, you create authentic brand experiences that generate organic buzz, reviews, and user generated content.

Our team handles the full process for you including campaign strategy, influencer selection, logistics, posting and reporting. This ensures your brand gets exposure through the right voices, while building a library of content that can be reused across paid ads, social channels and more.
‍

image.alt: Smiling woman with blonde curly hair holding a white box labeled 'swrl' towards the camera.

tabs.title: Influencer Affiliate program
tabs.html:
Our influencer affiliate programs transform one-off influencer campaigns into sustainable, revenue-driving growth channels. By converting top-performing influencers and loyal customers into affiliates, we build scalable systems that generate consistent sales while keeping costs low. Unlike traditional ad spend, this is a performance-based strategy where you only pay commission when a sale is made, delivering measurable ROI.

Affiliate marketing with influencers also expands your reach into new, highly targeted audiences across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and beyond. Affiliates create authentic user generated content (UGC) that builds trust and can be repurposed across your paid and organic marketing channels. With our full program management, recruitment and reward systems, your brand gains motivated advocates who consistently drive awareness, credibility and sales.
‍

image.alt: Influencer affiliate program at stride social

tabs.title: Content Creation for Paid & Organic socials (UGC)
tabs.html: One of the biggest challenges in paid advertising is generating enough high-converting content every week. Our content creation service makes this process effortless. We learn your brand’s USP and customer audience, then produce tailored videos that drive clicks and conversions. Each week, you receive the agreed number of performance-driven videos, ensuring your paid campaigns never run out of fresh content. We listen, we produce, we provide.

image.alt: Man wearing a headlamp and backpack crouching on rocks, holding a brown dog with an orange collar, in an outdoor setting with trees.

tabs.title: Mobile Game & App Ambassador Programs.
tabs.html:
Our influencer ambassador programs are designed to drive app downloads and build lasting trust with audiences. By activating over 50 brand ambassadors, we create daily content for your app or game on fresh TikTok accounts. Since TikTok gives strong preference to new profiles, we leverage this boost to maximize visibility and reach from day one.

This strategy delivers consistent exposure, authentic content, and measurable results, helping your app grow faster in a competitive market.

image.alt: Woman with long braided hair wearing a pink top speaking into a microphone with text overlay about an AI tool cloning anybody's voice.

tabs.title: Social Media Management
tabs.html:
If your brand isn’t posting consistently on Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook, you’re missing valuable opportunities to grow and connect with customers. Social media is where your audience spends their time, and a strong presence can be the difference between being overlooked or standing out.

Our creative team takes care of the entire process for you — from strategy and planning to content creation and publishing. We travel across the UK to capture high-quality, original content that reflects your brand values and speaks directly to your audience.

Think of us as your dedicated in-house social media team. We provide unlimited content, fresh ideas, and creative strategies that help your business increase visibility, build trust, and drive growth online.

Social media management is essential across industries including trades, dentists, restaurants, beauty salons, manufacturing, and real estate. Whatever your field, we ensure your brand is not just active but thriving.

image.alt: Two young women looking at a smartphone against a clear blue sky.

tabs.title: Brand Influencer Events
tabs.html:
If you want to create a memorable event around your product or venue, our team provides the expertise to bring your vision to life. From sourcing the perfect venue that reflects your brand values to managing décor, event styling, and full timeline coordination, we handle every detail.

We also curate guest lists that include influencers and celebrities, ensuring your event is not only well attended but also amplified online. Attendees actively share their experiences across social media, generating buzz and extending the reach of your event far beyond the venue.

This service is ideal for product launches, brand activations, and influencer relationship building, giving your brand both offline impact and online visibility.
